supersedes_part_of.part: additional_cio_decision (held positions kept subscribed via held-markets input)

reason: Public repo: a held-markets input surfaces open PAPER positions in public Actions logs and decision packets; keeping it current would require a secrets-write token for the private runtime.
decision: Realtime subscription = every admitted P3-12 market (TRADEABLE_UNIVERSE ∪ PAPER_ELIGIBLE), independent of the liquidity floor and of holdings. No held-markets input, secret, log field or subscribed_outside_floor field.
The ratified 30-day-average liquidity floor is applied in the decision as a per-market action cap (unchanged from addendum 1).
Record per-market realtime status for every subscribed market (not only candidates) so held markets retain exit freshness evidence.
A held market that leaves the admitted universe is covered by the private runtime/Ubuntu collector (private follow-up), never by public subscription changes.
